A list of spells available to be learned by the Ranger class upon level up.

Overview

The level column indicates spell level, not class level. Ranger spells are Known spells and cannot be changed after they are learned during through a level up.

Ranger spells will use the caster's Wisdom modifier for Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.
